scope_summary: The rendered 3D landscape of the audited build (f10fe585..., Chromium 141 headless shell, SwiftShader software WebGL, the harness page ?harness=1 at 1600x900 and 1280x720): 100 fixed captures (92 by the first attempt, 8 added here) across the six vantages x eight clocks, the three display factors, the ice, the landmarks and the troops at close range, inspected as 18 contact sheets and 14 full-resolution crops; one recorded glide (26 frames, 10 fps virtual clock); in-page numbers for the meres, the trees, the formations on the ice and the buildings (probe.json); the drawn facing of every block every 10 minutes 05:00-17:00 (facings.json, 2,051 rows) summarised. Judged separately for technical correctness, historical correctness and aesthetics. No source, data, test, threshold or build changed.

coverage.method: 6 vantage sheets (Field, Zuran, Pratzen, Allied, Overview, low Pratzen) at 06:00-16:30, the 1280x720 sheet
coverage.result: The 3D ground is restrained and legible; spires, the chateau and the meres give orientation. At the Field vantage the action fills the central ~40% of the frame and map text dominates; the low views keep the wall of formation names (decisions 255/263 (a), accepted; not re-judged here).

coverage.method: factor sheets (1x, 4x, 10.33x) at the low Pratzen view, the Field vantage, Sokolnitz and the Santon
coverage.result: 4x (default) reads naturally; 10.33x turns the Pratzeberg into a spike (by design of the factor); 1x shows the formations as footprints (decision 2B), large saturated patches in the low views. No finding.

coverage.method: the vantage matrix with the computed sun read back per capture (sunAlt, mist in shots/*.json)
coverage.result: Coherent through the day: 06:00 pre-dawn (sun -16.4 deg), 08:00 valley fog (mist 0.98), lifted by 10:00 (0.05), noon sun 19.0 deg, 15:00 evening mist (0.22), 16:30 twilight (sun -2.9 deg). No finding.

coverage.item: Water and ice, the low-sun glare
coverage.method: 8 ice views (8F/8H's) at 09:00-16:30, crops; probe.json (the ground under each disc); whites.json (saturated pixels)
coverage.result: Ice reads as frozen water from above and obliquely; the 15:00 low view's broad sheen as 8H measured (not re-measured). New: figures and trees on the Satschan ice (F1, F2); the streams' grazing reflection saturates (F5).

coverage.method: 12 troop views incl. the closest figure views at 4x (r 10) and 10.33x (r 8, 16); crops
coverage.result: Clear national identity and formation shapes; the rich kit reads close up. Contact on dry ground: no gross floating visible at capture resolution (not re-measured). On the meres the figures stand up to 0.874 units (62% of a man) below the ice (F1).

coverage.item: Troop orientation (S-5 rule) and uniform facings (decision 245 (a))
coverage.method: facings.json analysed (facings-summary.json); 6 read-back captures (yaw, heading, rule, nearest enemy) in shots/x-face-*.json
coverage.result: 84.5% of halted blocks within 1.5 km of an enemy face it within 45 deg; drifts set the facing (F3). Uniform facings not drawn, as decided.

The 1804 lozenge on French battalions, the Austrian yellow ordinary colour with the eagle, plain green Russian cloths (decision 98); at close range the cloths dominate the frame (sourced measures; 6D's ratio checks not re-run). No finding.
Spoked wheels, bracket trails, limbers, teams and a driver per team as 8E built; the limbered battery has no gunners (as recorded); the Santon's pieces alone. Carried items unchanged.

coverage.method: 19 landmark views, crops, probe.json's building records (BLDG)
coverage.result: Castle at 96x73 m smaller in plan than 11 of Sokolnitz's 13 farmstead long ranges (accepted, 266 (a)); Satschan church + 5 farmsteads (261 (a)); the garden barely legible; notDrawn landmarks absent with a misreading risk (F7); blocks interpenetrate buildings (F4).

coverage.method: one recorded glide (Field to Pratzen vantage, 10:00, 26 frames, 10 fps virtual clock, the app's own loop), frame diffs
coverage.result: Smooth glide, culling 0 to 76 blocks with no visible pop; at rest the frame's triangles fell 1,151,029 to 1,003,941 with no 3D pixel change (2,830 px changed, all label fades). Depth artefacts: figures sunk in the ice (F1); crown facets near the eye (F8).
0 warnings or errors in 100 captures; desktop tier (lowTier false) throughout.

findings.title: Figures on the frozen Satschan mere are drawn sunk into the ice in the ponds phase
findings.subsystem: world.js meres (mereLevel, buildWater) / app.js figure seating
findings.user_impact: At the battle's best-known moment (phase 9, 16:00-17:00) Dokhturov's men, Kienmayer's riders and Buxhowden's camp on the ice look as if they are breaking through it: horses legless, men cut at the thigh. That is a visual claim of the mass-drowning story the narrative keeps disputed (data.js:119, 749; analysis.js:60). Seen when a visitor zooms to the meres (about r 20 units or closer); invisible at the Overview.
refs: world.js:1380-1385 (mereLevel: the ice at or below the lowest shore ground minus 0.05)
world.js:1454 (8F: depthWrite false, 'nothing visible lies under the ice')
data.js:465, 480, 495 (phase-9 legs ice:true: buxhowden, kienmayer, dok)
findings.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/probe.json (under: Satschan 69% of the disc's ground below the ice, mean 0.266, max 0.874 units; Menitz 78%, max 1.142; formationsInside: kienmayer, dok, buxhowden, friant 16:00-17:00 at depths up to 0.874; kitArt headTop 1.415); docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/shots/x-ice-dok-1640.jpg, x-ice-dok-1640-low.jpg, x-ice-bux-1620.jpg; crops/satschan-1200-0-0.jpg (a rider on the ice at 12:00, horse legs hidden)
findings.expected: A formation the data puts on the ice stands on the ice surface.
findings.observed: Blocks are seated on groundY, the carved bed under the disc, up to 0.874 units (62% of a man's 1.415) below the ice plane; the ice (transparent 0.96, depth-tested) covers the sunk parts. The self-test's contact check judges the drawn ground, so it passes.
findings.remedy: Seat figures, horses, guns and the HQ camp at max(groundY, the disc's ice level) inside a mere's disc (presentation only), or flatten the drawn bed to the ice level under the disc; add a self-test check that every figure inside a disc stands at the ice surface; re-run the contact check.
findings.repro: Harness page 1600x900, Watch, 4x; __aus.apply({t:1000, aim:{map:'dok', dir:[0.55,0.45,0.70], r:16}}) (16:40); or node tools/audit-post8/visual-landscape/probe.js out.json
findings.cause_verified: yes: probe.json reads the disc level (-4.14) against groundY at the blocks' places

findings.title: Trees and bushes stand on the frozen Satschan mere
findings.user_impact: 21 deciduous trees and bushes appear to grow out of the ice next to Satschan and Telnitz, in every view of the meres (the ponds' finale, the Telnitz fighting); a visible geography error.
refs: world.js:2119-2127 (village trees on a ring round each village, no water test)
world.js:2212-2223 (bank scrub along GOLDBACH and LITAVA: tests village cover and buildings only)
world.js:53 (LITAVA_M through Satschan, crossing the mere)
findings.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/probe.json (trees.onIceCount 21 inside the drawn disc, 17 on the water class: 4 village trees, 17 'stream' scrub; none on the Menitz mere); docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/village-trees.json (the planner's own arithmetic: 3 of 184 village trees on the water class, Telnitz 1, Satschan 2); crops/satschan-1200-0-0.jpg; shots/telnitz-0930-wide.jpg
findings.expected: No tree or scrub inside a mere's drawn ice (decision 246 (a): nothing added on the ice).
findings.observed: 4 village trees and 17 bank-scrub bushes inside the Satschan disc.
findings.remedy: Skip a village tree or bank bush inside a disc (or where coverClass is water) without changing the draws consumed, then re-pin the woods counts and confirm no building plan moves (the WOODS_RS hold).
findings.cause_verified: yes (code read and positions computed in the page)

findings.title: Blocks face along slow drifts and keep stale facings, so some face away from an adjacent enemy
findings.user_impact: Close up, formations in contact show their backs to the enemy: Kamensky's brigade ('counterattack', then 'engaged') faces 130-180 deg away from Saint-Hilaire at 10:00-11:00, 20-420 m off (within 110 m at 10:00-10:20) at the moment the event reads 'Kamensky turns his brigade about'; Saint-Hilaire faces 143-152 deg away from Kamensky (40-90 m) at 09:40-09:50. The rich kit (8E) makes facing legible.
refs: app.js:6001-6002 (want=headingAt(id,clock); else enemyFacing)
app.js:3336-3345 (headingAt: any leg in progress, whatever its rate)
app.js:5740-5774 (faceClock, enemyFacing: nearest enemy at the phase start or arrival)
docs/STAGE8_SPEC.md:826-834 (drifts under 1 km/h: no gait swing, decision 244 (a))
findings.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/facings-summary.json (2,051 rows; drifts under 1 km/h 1,146 of 1,440 moving rows, 79.6%; 37 rows with an enemy within 0.5 km and the yaw >120 deg off it, 17 with a fighting status, 29 of them moving; convention check 136/161 = 84.5% halted-near within 45 deg); docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/shots/x-face-kamensky-1010.json (yaw 174.8 deg off Saint-Hilaire 0.06 km, moving 0.49 km/h), x-face-sthilaire-0950.json (-142.7 deg, 0.043 km), x-face-prz-0910.json (halted, 152 deg off Legrand 0.322 km), x-face-dok-1350.json (halted, 127.1 deg off Bourcier 0.235 km)
findings.expected: A formation in contact faces its opponent unless the data says it turned away; a drift the gait does not animate does not turn the block.
findings.observed: The yaw follows the drift's heading at any rate; a halted block keeps the facing taken toward the nearest enemy at the phase start or on arrival, however the enemy moves.
findings.remedy: Below the gait's 1 km/h floor use the enemy rule (or the leg's start facing) instead of the drift's heading; re-take a halted block's facing when its nearest enemy changes materially within a phase; keep S-5 (a function of the clock) and its self-test check (g).
findings.repro: node tools/audit-post8/visual-landscape/facings.js <iso-root> out.json (~14 min load); capture shots-extra.json
findings.cause_verified: yes (read-backs of yaw, heading and rule)
findings.judgement_kind: design + historical; the 'nearest enemy' reference and thresholds are this audit's design values
findings.risk: A wholesale change could make blocks spin under scrubbing; keep the WHEEL easing and S-5.

findings.title: Formation blocks interpenetrate buildings and each other
findings.subsystem: app.js block placement vs world.js BLDG (8G buildings at plot scale)
findings.user_impact: Horses and men stand inside houses (Nansouty's cuirassiers in Blasowitz at 10:55; Telnitz at 08:00; the Posoritz post house at 15:00), opposing blocks share ground (Kamensky and Saint-Hilaire at 10:10). Reads as clipping rather than occupation; worst in the villages that carry the narrative (Sokolnitz, Telnitz).
refs: docs/STAGE8_SPEC.md:4982-4986 ('figures are drawn over buildings everywhere', recorded in 8J, not decided)
world.js BLDG / planBuildings8g (world.js:1921)
findings.expected: Either figures kept clear of drawn buildings or buildings under an occupying block visibly subordinated.
findings.observed: No separation; farmsteads drawn at the building convention (a long range up to 176 x 71 m, probe.json) enlarge the overlap.
findings.remedy: An owner decision first: hide or fade building parts under a block's footprint, or offset figure rows clear of them; the castle case stays under decision 266 (a).

findings.title: Streams saturate to white in grazing and low-sun views
findings.user_impact: In the low views (the Pratzen vantage at 10:00, the low Pratzen view at 16:30, the climb at 09:00) the brooks become glowing white lines, the brightest thing in the frame, drawing the eye from the troops and readable as roads or highlights; toward the sun at 15:00 the Litava's channel reads as a white wall.
refs: world.js:1409 (STREAM.sky 2.0)
world.js:1446 (radiance *= 1 + 2.0*sG^3 at a grazing view)
findings.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-landscape/whites.json (236 px at 255 in the brook toward Augezd, v-low-1630; 32 in the Goldbach by Puntowitz, inf-east-0900; 41 behind the castle at 15:00; the Litava channel up to 236 in ice-mid-1500); crops/v-low-1630-900-250.jpg, inf-east-0900-1000-0.jpg, ice-mid-1500-250-80.jpg, sok-castle-1500-close-300-0.jpg
findings.observed: A grazing gain of up to 3x on the environment radiance plus the bloom clips the ribbons to white.
findings.remedy: Lower STREAM.sky (e.g. 0.7) or clamp the stream's radiance, measured as 8H measured ICE.sky (ice-8h.js) across the low views.
findings.cause_verified: inferred from the shader term; not toggled here

findings.title: Headquarters drawn as a pitched camp at every status
findings.subsystem: app.js HQ block (GEO.tent marquee + four tents)
findings.user_impact: A white pyramid 2.3 units high (1.6x a man) appears among moving guns (14:10) and on the Satschan ice during the rout (16:20-16:40); close up it reads as an unexplained object rather than a staff.
refs: app.js:811 (GEO.tent ConeGeometry(1.75,2.3,4))
findings.expected: A moving or withdrawing headquarters drawn as a mounted group.
findings.observed: The camp is drawn wherever the HQ is, whatever its status.
findings.remedy: Show the marquee only while the HQ is halted (or never at close range); the riders alone while it moves.

findings.title: Omitted chapels invite a misreading: Bosenitz's church appears to crown the Santon; St Anthony's name stands beside Augezd's church
findings.user_impact: From the south-west views the Bosenitz church, about 720 m beyond the Santon, sits behind the hill's top next to the label 'The Santon'; above Augezd the label 'Chapel of St Anthony' floats over an empty patch with Augezd's drawn church beside it. A visitor can take either church for the chapel the map deliberately omits.
refs: appearance.js:1065-1068 (notDrawn: stAnthony, santon, granary)
world.js:140, 152 (Bosenitz [236,69] with a church), world.js:249 (SANTON=W(222,87))
findings.expected: An omitted landmark is not visually substituted by another building.
findings.observed: As described; the omission itself is reasoned (form, destruction hour and date not read).
findings.remedy: Owner choice among notDrawn's alternatives; at least a site marker or a dossier line saying the chapel is not drawn and why.

findings.title: Deciduous crowns near the eye show large faceted shards
findings.user_impact: In the closest figure views next to woods (Saint-Hilaire's climb at 4x r 10 and 10.33x r 8, the castle close) the crowns break into large brown triangles like broken glass.
refs: docs/STAGE8_SPEC.md:4547-4549 (8H: still open, twigs would need another representation)
docs/STAGE8_SPEC.md:4699-4700 (listed open)
findings.expected: Crowns read as bare twig masses at every distance.
findings.remedy: As 8H recorded: an alpha-tested twig representation within a few units of the eye, measured for overdraw; or keep and accept.

strengths: Light and atmosphere computed and coherent through the day: pre-dawn, the valley fog lifting by 10:00, a low winter sun, evening mist and twilight (sun -2.9 deg at 16:30)
A restrained December palette: olive-brown fields, bare grey-brown woods with green conifers, grey haze; the meres read as frozen water from above and obliquely, the rimed margin lighter
Villages read as villages on the 1825 street-and-yard pattern; spires, the chateau and the castle's quadrangle (close up) give a landmark hierarchy

Troops identifiable at a glance by side and nation (French blue and white with the 1804 lozenge, Russian green, Austrian white with the yellow ordinary colour); formations legible as columns and lines; the rich kit and the artillery (spoked wheels, trails, limbers, teams) convincing close up
No visible culling or level-of-detail pop in the recorded glide; 0 console warnings or errors in 100 captures
